Commentary.Commentary: What a match we have witnessed today, where both the teams fought like champions! The Windies are one up in this 2-match series and it will a challenge for the World No. 2 ranked side to save their standing. The forecast might spell trouble with a thunderstorm brewing but, fingers crossed, the weather stays clear. Join us at 1930 IST tomorrow for the 2nd match at Lauderhill, Florida. Until then, take care and cheers!

West Indies captain, Carlos Brathwaite says it was a tough chance. (On the last ball) He shares the conversation he had and his decision to trust Bravo, who wanted to bowl a slower ball. Praises Bravo for winning it for the team. (On the win) He credits all the players for playing so well and congratulates them on the overall challenge to win it. (On the support) He smirks and says that it was not easy to tell who the crowd was cheering for throughout the game.
Evin Lewis has been awarded the Man of the Match award for his maiden T20I century.

Indian captain, MS Dhoni says that it was an amazing game but it was above par scoring 250. He also says that he couldn't ask any more from the batting unit and that they tried hard. He feels that they failed to win on the last ball because the planning was good but the execution was poor. (On the chase) He opines that it was a great effort to play at a good run rate. He reveals that they kept the required run rate low when they had a partnership going as it allows the lower order to play and be in the game. Credits Rahul and the other batsmen for such a great show. (On the crowd) He states that the team got an amazing response. Clarifies that fans come out and support them no matter where they play but that it feels good to play in the USA for the first time.

The pair put up a lightning partnership of 107 runs and took the Indians to the verge of victory. The crowd were in for a treat and expressed their delight loudly. Third time is the charm as Bravo struck down Dhoni in the very last ball to clinch the win.

The Indians found themselves on shaky ground but Rohit Sharma was in fine form. He held on to the other end, scoring a half century and paired with KL Rahul. They put up a vital 89-run stand together which was finally broken up by Kieron Pollard. With more than half the overs bowled and the odds stacked against them, Rahul and Dhoni took up the challenge to withstand the Caribbean tide.

An electrifying finish to an unforgettable game! West Indies have snatched victory from the jaws of defeat in nail-biting fashion. After putting a mammoth score on the board, the Windies bowlers bowled well to take two early wickets in quick succession. Rahane was sent back off a blinder from Bravo, who came on with the ball to take out the famed Kohli.

OUT! Bravo, you champion! West Indies have won this dramatic match! Serves it slower outside off, Dhoni walks across and looks to play it to the off side. The ball catches an outside edge and this time Marlon Samuels takes a dolly at short third man. WINDIES WIN BY 1 RUN and they all are doing the champion dance.
2 needed off 1. West Indies are up and alert trying their best to win it as lot of fielding changes are made. Dhoni is all cool...
Yorker ball on middle and off, Dhoni drills it and the ball goes off his hands and they cross for a brace. The ball goes towards long on and Dhoni sprints back for a brace.
Serves it quicker on the stumps, Rahul goes deep in his crease and it is pushed to long on for a single.
Leg bye! On the pads, juicy ball to put it away. Dhoni misses it and the ball goes off his pads to the leg side. Leg bye is taken.
Full ball outside off, Rahul pushes it through covers for a single.

Dropped! Slower ball outside off, Dhoni sees it early and he goes all guns blazing to loft that. It goes off an outside edge straight into the hands of Marlon Samuels at short third man but can you believe it? He has dropped that. Bravo cannot believe it too. Single is taken.
Bravo to bowl the final over.
Length ball on middle and leg, Rahul flicks it through mid-wicket for another brace. 100-run stand is up between these two. 8 needed off 6.
Length ball outside off, Lokesh pushes it over covers for a brace.
Wide! Bouncer down the leg side, left alone and it is given as wide.
FOUR! He is unstoppable! Full ball on off, Rahul lofts it over covers for one bounce boundary. Just a matter of time, India will see themselves home.
Maiden T20I century for KL Rahul.

SIX! Maiden T20I century for this young lad! Full ball outside off, Rahul sits deep in his crease and steers it over third man for a biggie. What a gem of an innings by this boy. Dhoni ask him to celebrate for such an amazing knock. India inching home.
Brilliant bouncer! It is bowled up outside middle and off, Rahul ducks under it and lets it through.
Fuller ball on the pads, Dhoni flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Russell back on for this penultimate over.
Full ball on off, pushed to covers for a single. 24 needed off 12.
The atmosphere is electric with the crowd alternating between chanting for Rahul and Dhoni.

Leg bye! Perfect yorker! Bravo bowls a perfect yorker and Rahul has no answer for it. The ball goes on to his left toe yet again. Dwayne appeals for an LBW but it is turned down. Lokesh is on the ground but completes a run. Leg bye given.
Back of a length ball outside off, MS stays back and cuts it through point for a single.
Hurls it on the pads, Dhoni jams it to mid-wicket for a quick brace.
Full on off, driven to covers. Good dot ball.
FOUR! Full toss on the pads, Dhoni flicks it fine through sqaure leg for a boundary. Clever, very clear from MS.
Bravo back on.

SIX! Rahul joins the party too! Short ball around off, Lokesh clears his front foot and slogs it over mid-wicket stand. He moves on to 94 with that. India are up for a highest chase ever if they can achieve this feat. 33 needed of last 3 now.
Bowls much fuller on middle and off, Dhoni works it down to long on for a single.

SIX! Massive and that's Dhoni for you! Short ball outside off, MS goes across and pulls that from outside off for a huge six over mid-wicket. He is up to something and we will have to wait and watch. What lightning strike that! 40 needed off 20.
Hurls a length ball on off, driven to covers.
SIX! Dhoni,Dhoni chants are on! Full ball outside off, MS was gearing up for it and he slams that too hard and over long on for a biggie. 200 up for India. Will Dhoni finish it off for India?
Wide! Too full and wide outside off, Dhoni lets it through and it is given as a wide.
Slower ball outside off, Dhoni drives it a bit early and it goes to the fielder.
Andre Russell back on.
Slow ball on middle and leg, Dhoni pushes it to mid-wicket for a single. MS wanted a brace but was denied. 53 needed of 24 now.
On middle and leg, worked to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Driven! Full ball outside off, Rahul sets back and cuts it through backward point for another boundary. He can play such shots all over the park.
50-run stand between Dhoni and Rahul.
Back of a length ball outside off, Dhoni taps it to short third man and a quick single is taken.
Rahul goes too deep and down the leg side, Pollard is a smart bowler so he follows him. At the end, he is cramped and could only manage a single to the leg side.
Slower ball on middle and leg, Dhoni glances that fine through square leg. It allows these two to take three runs.
Pollard back on.
FOUR! Classical! Full ball outside off, Rahul likes that as he lofts it neatly over covers to pick a boundary. He is dealing in boundaries.

Full ball outside off, Rahul walks across and looks to scoop it up but the ball goes on to hit his left toe. The ball dies on the track and Brathwaite picks it up. 68 needed off 31, it is setting out to be a nail-biter.
Serves it full outside off, Rahul stays deep and drives it through covers for a brace. Brilliant running up there.
Tad short on the pads, Dhoni tucks it to square leg for a single.
Full ball on middle and leg, Rahul sensibly pushes it long on for a single.
SIX! Up and over! Pitches it up outside off, Rahul stays deep in his crease and lofts it. The ball goes off the edge over third man for a biggie. He is setting up a tone here at Florida.
Brathwaite back on.
On middle and leg, swept to the leg side for a single. 78 needed off 36 now. Close game.
FOUR! Flighted ball on off, KL Rahul goes deep in his crease and lofts it towards long off, Pollard misfields and it goes to touch the ropes.
Wide! Down the leg side, left alone and the umpire calls it a wide.
There is some sightscreen issues...
Floats it up on off, driven through wide of mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Reverse sweep! Loopy ball on off, Rahul kneels and reverse sweeps it through slip cordon for a rocketing boundary.
Serves it on off, blocked beautifully.
SIX! Dispatched! Tossed up ball around off, rahul comes ahead and lofts it over covers for a maximum. Good use of feet there by the young lad.
Narine back on.

Dhoni is reminding us of his old days! Full ball on middle and off, Dhoni stays tall and lofts it over the bowler's head. The ball goes in the deep and Pollard does well to stop that ball with his foot work. Brace taken. 150 up for India, match is going to a livewire mode.
Pitches it up and on middle and leg, Dhoni works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahul off his back foot steers it fine to third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Trademark Dhoni! Full ball outside off, Dhoni kneels on his knee and drives it nonchalantly through covers. A good stop in the deep saves two runs.
FOUR! Starts off with a boundary! Short ball on middle and leg, Dhoni pulls it ever so well through square leg for a welcome boundary.
Brathwaite back on.
Short ball outside off, MS Dhoni cuts it through backward point for a single.
MS Dhoni is the new man in.

OUT! Pollard gets his man! Serves it from way behind the bowling line and slower in pace. Rohit goes for a pull shot. The ball goes deep in the mid-wicket region. It had distance but lacked elevation. Johnson takes a sitter and with that a good knock is over. Also an 89-run stand is broken too. Game on.
Slower ball on off, cut to point for no runs.
Wide! Cheeky from Rohi! Down the leg side, left alone and wide is given.
Slower ball on off, pulled with ease to mid-wicket for a single.
Maiden T20I fifty for KL Rahul.

FOUR! Fine way to bring up his feat! Short ball outside off, Rahul gets deep in his crease and cuts it over backward point for a racy boundary. He is playing some great strokes and it is a pleasure to watch him play.
Slower ball on middle and leg, Rahul tries to put it away but is hit on the pads.
SIX! Sent into orbit! Full toss on middle and leg, all Rohit had to do was to put that ball away. He pulls it elegantly over deep mid-wicket for another biggie of his innings.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahul punches it off his back foot. It is a misfield and brace is on.
Pitches it up on off, Rahul scoops it to square leg for a single. Sensible batting here from these twos.
Bravo serves it on off, Rohit drives it through covers for a single.
Fuller ball on off, Rahul plays it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Full toss on of, Rahul pulls it neatly through mid-wicket for a boundary. Poor ball and it is being punished.
Dwayne Bravo back on.
Serves it on the pads, chipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Slower ball on off, Rahul gets cramped and can only play it back to Pollard.
Fuller ball on the pads, worked to the leg side for a single. Good cricket here.
11th T20I fifty for Rohit Sharma.
SIX! What a way to bring up his fifty! Full ball on middle and leg, Rohit shimmies to the pitch of the ball and lofts just over long on for a maximum.
Serves it from wide outside the crease, Rahul punches it to mid on for a single.
Bowls a slow ball on middle and leg, Rohit pushes it to long on. Single was on but the overthrows made it three. Poor fielding there.
Kieron Pollard to bowl next.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the covers.

DROPPED! A COSTLY MISTAKE! Fuller ball around off, Rahul looks to loft this high but doesn't quite get his bat under it and the ball loops over to Andre Russell at the covers. He gets ready to cup it with both hands but the ball slides through and hits the ground. The batsmen take advantage and run a couple. How expensive that mistake was is yet to be seen.
Length ball outside off, pushed to point.
FOUR! Very full delivery on middle and leg, Rahul works it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
50-run stand between Rohit and Rahul.
Fuller ball on the stumps, played to mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish delivery, defended from within the crease for a single.
Flighted around off, Rahul gets down and goes for a reverse sweep but only gets a single out of it.
Full outside off, driven through mid on for a single.
SIX! SLOGGED! Landed on off and again, Rohit goes for it. He launches into a slog sweep that sails over the fielders heads and over the mid on boundary!
SIX! LOFTED! Served outside off, Sharma gets down on one knee and slogs it. He hits it with the toe end of the bat but the ball makes it to long on and over the fence.
Rohit defends it off the front foot with a straight bat.
Landed outside off, Sharma flicks it uppishly through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! SUPERBLY DONE! Full delivery outside off, Rahul drives it wonderfully through the covers for a boundary. Good over for India.
FOUR! DRIVEN! Full outside off, Rahul finally breaks through the outfield with a slightly angled drive through backward point and across the boundary.
Fuller ball outside off, this time Rahul miscues it, getting a top edge sends the ball soaring over the covers for a couple.
Fullish ball outside off, pushed by Sharma through point for a single.
Another full ball and Rahul drives it through point for a single.
Full ball outside off, Sharma square drives it for a single.
Carlos Brathwaite to bowl now.
Serves it on off, Rahul blocks it off his front foot.
FOUR! Punched! Floats it around middle and off, KL goes back and slams it through cover-point for a boundary. He is looking lethal here.
Serves it on the pads, pushed to mid-wicket for a brace.
Bowls it full on off, defended neatly.
SIX! Launched it! Loopy ball outside off, Rahul shimmies to the pitch of the ball and sends it high and deep into the long off stand for a maximum.
FOUR! Tossed up around off, Rahul Sweeps it well over square leg for a boundary.
Sunil Narine to bowl next.
Again, Rahul flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, worked down the leg side for a couple.
KL Rahul to bat next, replacing Kohli.

OUT! THAT IS WICKET NO. 50 FOR BRAVO! Short on leg, Kohli looks to stand back and pull it but the ball grazes past his gloves and goes to the left of the keeper, who dives to collect it. That is a HUGE WICKET FOR WI and a feather in the cap for Bravo!
Shorter delivery, pulled through mid on for a single.
Full delivery on the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Kohli leans forward and guides it through third man and across the boundary line.
Dwayne Bravo to bowl next.
Virat plays is through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! SMASHED! Short delivery on the stumps, Kohli stays back, waiting and lofts it over the bowler's head and down the ground for a boundary.
Short delivery around off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Flatter ball around off, punched off the back foot.
FOUR! SLASHED! Short ball outside off, Kohli cuts it through the off side, finding the gap in the covers and sends the ball racing across the ropes.
Full on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket.
Virat Kohli is the new man in, replacing Rahane.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! Bravo, Dwayne! Length ball around off, Rahane leans back, opening the face of his bat and making clever use of the pace to send it flying over the keeper and to the boundary at third man. Bravo runs in and takes a fantastically athletic catch. That was a brilliant dive and not only does he save the runs but gets India's first man!
Length ball outside off, Sharma steps forward and pushes it but miscues it down the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Short on off, Sharma pulls it hard and sends it rocketing through mid-wicket.
Full on middle and leg, Sharma works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Rahane has taken a beating on his helmet and he is seeking some attention.

OUCH! Short ball outside off, Rahane looks to pull it but misjudges the length and edges it onto his helmet. The batsmenpick up a single. Rahane is clearly shaken as he removes his helmet and rubs his head.
FOUR! FLICKED! An attempted yorker on middle and leg, Rahane joins in the fun with a wristy shot that sends the ball racing past the fence at fine leg.
Another one from Sharma! Length ball on the stumps, Sharma bounds forward and lofts it over mid off for a magnificent boundary!
Full delivery, Rahane drives it through mid on.
On the stumps, Sharma punches it off the back foot.
FOUR! LOFTED! Fuller around off, Sharma goes for a big one and the ball sails overhead. The umpires confer before deciding to signal it as a boundary as the ball bounced just inside.
FOUR! A bit wide outside off, Sharma slashes it through point. The ball goes all the way and that's the first boundary for India!
Fuller ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Samuel Badree to bowl from the other end.
Bouncer! Rahane does well to duck under it.
Very full delivery on off, defended off the front foot.
Short ball on middle, defended from within the crease for a single.
Shortish delivery on the pads, Rahane flicks it to the man at square leg for a single. There is a slight chance of a run out but it required a direct hit.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed through extra cover as India get off the mark with a brace.
We are back for the chase. Rohit Sharma and Ajinkya Rahane will open and Andre Russell will bowl first up. Here we go...
